name: Edmund Bernstein
original_name: エドマンド＝バーンスタイン
source:
[i]"Power is all that matters, Edward. If you don't understand that, then you have no business inheriting this household."[/i]

The current head of the Bernstein house, and Edward and Lilly's father. He's incredibly loyal to the Queen. A stern meritocrat, he often quarrels with his son, who he thinks would be a weak successor to the house.

He's fully prepared to become a stepping stone in the mission to create a world where the weak have been weeded out, and only the strong exist.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/mistonia/characters/edmund/]Aksys Games[/url]]
